title: Sample Preparation for GCTOF Analysis in Metabolomics
author: Oliver Fiehn
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ytjfwkn
materials: Sample Preparation: (1). Switch on bath to pre-cool at –20°C (±2°C validity temperature range) (2). Gently rotate or aspirate the blood samples for about 10s to obtain a homogenised sample. (3). Aliquot 30l of plasma sample to a 1.0 mL extraction solution. The extraction solution has to be pre-chilled using the ThermoElectron Neslab RTE 740 cooling bath set to -20°C. (4). Vortex the sample for about 10s and shake for 5 min at 4°C using the Orbital Mixing Chilling/Heating Plate. If you are using more than one sample, keep the rest of the sample on ice (chilled at <0°C with sodium chloride). (5). Centrifuge samples for 2min at 14000 rcf using the centrifuge Eppendorf 5415 D. (6). Aliquot two 450µL portions of the supernatant. One for analysis and one for a backup sample. Store the backup aliquot in -20°C freezer. (7). Evaporate one 450µL aliquots of the sample in the Labconco Centrivap cold trap concentrator to complete dryness. (8). The dried aliquot is then re-suspended with 450 µL 50% acetonitrile (degassed as given above). (9). Centrifuged for 2 min at 14000 rcf using the centrifuge Eppendorf 5415. (10). Remove supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube. (11). Evaporate the supernatant to dryness in the Labconco Centrivap cold trap concentrator. (12). Submit to derivatization.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction solvent solution using acetonitrile, isopropanol, and water.

substeps.instruction: Check the pH of acetonitrile and isopropanol using wetted pH paper to ensure it is pH 7.
Mix acetonitrile, isopropanol, and water in a volume proportion of 3:3:2.
Degas the extraction solution mix for 5 minutes with nitrogen using small bubbles, ensuring the nitrogen line was flushed of air prior to use.

steps.title: Prepare MeOX Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 40mg/mL methoxyamine hydrochloride (MeOX) solution in pyridine.

substeps.instruction: Weigh methoxyamine hydrochloride into a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube and add the appropriate amount of pyridine.
Vortex the solution and sonicate at 60ºC for 15 minutes to dissolve.

steps.title: Perform First Derivatization
steps.instruction: Derivatize the dried samples and standards using the MeOX solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of the 40mg/mL MeOX solution to each dried sample and standard.
Shake at maximum speed at 30ºC for 1.5 hours.

steps.title: Prepare MSTFA and FAME Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a derivatization mixture of MSTFA and FAME marker.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of FAME marker to 1mL of MSTFA.

steps.title: Perform Second Derivatization
steps.instruction: Derivatize the samples using the MSTFA + FAME mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 91 µL of the MSTFA + FAME mixture to each sample and standard.
Shake at maximum speed at 37 ºC.

steps.title: Prepare for GCTOF MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer contents to glass vials with micro-serts inserted and cap immediately.

steps.title: Implement Quality Assurance
steps.instruction: Perform quality control extractions for each sequence.

substeps.instruction: Perform one blank negative control extraction following the total procedure without a biological sample.
Use one commercial plasma/serum pool sample per 10 authentic subject samples as a control.
If commercial blood is unavailable, prepare a large pool sample by aliquoting 100 µL per 1 mL plasma sample, then use 1 pool extract per 10 authentic subject samples.
Prepare at least one NIST plasma extract using the same manner.
